_note: Career catalog. Trait overrides adjust the sector prototype (expert estimates until mapped to O*NET). Salaries (lakh/yr, metro, median), demand and velocity are illustrative estimates; see docs/DATA_TRUTH.md.

careers.name: Data Scientist
careers.typical_entry_education: B.Tech / B.Sc in CS, Data Science or Statistics
careers.short_description: Turns messy data into decisions with statistics, machine learning and clear storytelling.

careers.name: Software Engineer
careers.short_description: Designs, builds and maintains the software people use every day.

careers.name: AI / ML Engineer
careers.short_description: Builds and deploys machine-learning systems, from recommendation engines to vision models.

careers.name: Cybersecurity Analyst
careers.short_description: Protects organisations from hackers by finding weaknesses and responding to attacks.

careers.name: Cloud & DevOps Engineer
careers.short_description: Keeps apps running reliably on cloud platforms and automates how software ships.

careers.name: Civil Engineer
careers.short_description: Plans and builds roads, bridges, buildings and water systems.

careers.name: Mechanical Engineer
careers.short_description: Designs and improves machines, engines and manufacturing systems.

careers.name: Electrical Engineer
careers.short_description: Works on power generation, grids, motors and electrical systems.

careers.name: Robotics & Automation Engineer
careers.short_description: Builds machines that sense, decide and act, from factory arms to farm robots.

careers.name: Electronics & VLSI Chip Engineer
careers.short_description: Designs and verifies the microchips inside phones, cars and satellites.

careers.name: Doctor (MBBS)
careers.typical_entry_education: MBBS (5.5 years incl. internship) via NEET-UG
careers.short_description: Diagnoses and treats patients; a long training path with high social trust.

careers.name: Biomedical Engineer
careers.short_description: Designs medical devices, diagnostics and hospital technology.

careers.name: Computational Biologist
careers.short_description: Uses code and models to decode genomes, proteins and disease.

careers.name: Pharmacist
careers.short_description: Prepares and dispenses medicines and advises patients on safe use.

careers.name: Registered Nurse
careers.short_description: Cares for patients, gives treatment and supports doctors; strong demand in India and abroad.

careers.name: Physiotherapist
careers.short_description: Helps people recover movement after injury, surgery or illness.

careers.name: Biotechnologist
careers.short_description: Uses living cells and molecules to develop medicines, vaccines and better crops.

careers.name: UX / Product Designer
careers.short_description: Researches users and designs digital products that are useful and delightful.

careers.name: Architect
careers.typical_entry_education: B.Arch (5 years) via NATA / JEE Main Paper 2
careers.short_description: Designs buildings and spaces that are safe, beautiful and sustainable.

careers.name: Animator / VFX Artist
careers.typical_entry_education: B.Des / B.Sc Animation or diploma + portfolio
careers.short_description: Brings films, games and ads to life with animation and visual effects.

careers.name: Fashion Designer
careers.short_description: Designs clothing and accessories, from concept sketches to production.

careers.name: Industrial / Product Designer
careers.short_description: Designs physical products, from kitchen tools to medical devices.

careers.name: Chartered Accountant
careers.short_description: Audits accounts, advises on tax and keeps businesses financially healthy.

careers.name: Financial Analyst
careers.typical_entry_education: B.Com / BBA / Economics + CFA or MBA
careers.short_description: Analyses companies and markets to guide investment decisions.

careers.name: Startup Founder / Entrepreneur
careers.typical_entry_education: Any degree; incubators and practical experience
careers.short_description: Builds a business around a problem worth solving; high risk, high autonomy.

careers.name: Marketing Manager
careers.short_description: Plans campaigns that help products reach and win customers.

careers.name: Actuary
careers.short_description: Uses mathematics and statistics to measure risk for insurers and pension funds.

careers.name: Lawyer
careers.short_description: Advises clients, drafts agreements and argues cases in court.

careers.name: Civil Servant (IAS / IPS / IFS)
careers.typical_entry_education: Any graduate degree + UPSC Civil Services
careers.short_description: Runs districts, policies and public services; very competitive selection.

careers.name: Public Policy Analyst
careers.short_description: Researches problems and evaluates government programmes with data.

careers.name: School Teacher
careers.typical_entry_education: B.Sc / B.A + B.Ed; CTET or state TET
careers.short_description: Teaches and mentors students; stable government and private-school roles.

careers.name: Research Scientist
careers.short_description: Discovers new knowledge in labs and research institutes.

careers.name: Special Educator
careers.short_description: Teaches and supports children with disabilities and learning differences.

careers.name: Journalist
careers.short_description: Finds, checks and tells stories that inform the public.

careers.name: Digital Marketing & Content Specialist
careers.short_description: Grows audiences online with content, ads and analytics.

careers.name: Agri-Drone & Precision Farming Engineer
careers.short_description: Applies drones, sensors and analytics to raise farm yields and cut input waste.

careers.name: Agronomist / Agricultural Officer
careers.short_description: Advises farmers on crops, soil and pests; government and agri-business roles.

careers.name: Environmental Scientist
careers.short_description: Measures pollution and protects air, water and ecosystems.

careers.name: Climate & Sustainability Analyst
careers.typical_entry_education: B.Sc / B.Tech + climate or data courses
careers.short_description: Uses data to track emissions and plan climate action for companies and cities.

careers.name: Food Technologist
careers.short_description: Develops, preserves and safety-tests the food we buy.

careers.name: Electric Vehicle Engineer
careers.short_description: Designs batteries, motors and charging systems for electric vehicles.

careers.name: Solar & Renewable Energy Engineer
careers.short_description: Plans and installs solar and wind systems for homes, farms and industry.

careers.name: Chemical Engineer
careers.short_description: Designs processes that turn raw materials into fuels, medicines and materials.

careers.name: Textile Technologist
careers.short_description: Improves how fabrics are made, dyed and finished; big employers in Tiruppur, Surat and Coimbatore.

careers.name: Aerospace Engineer
careers.short_description: Designs aircraft, drones, rockets and satellites.

careers.name: Commercial Pilot
careers.typical_entry_education: CPL from a DGCA-approved flying school
careers.short_description: Flies passenger and cargo aircraft; expensive training, strong pay.

careers.name: Merchant Navy Officer
careers.typical_entry_education: B.Sc Nautical Science / Marine Engineering via IMU-CET
careers.short_description: Navigates or maintains cargo ships on international routes.

careers.name: Automobile Engineer
careers.short_description: Designs, tests and services cars, two-wheelers and commercial vehicles.

careers.name: Hotel & Hospitality Manager
careers.short_description: Runs hotels, resorts and restaurants and leads service teams.

careers.name: Chef / Culinary Professional
careers.short_description: Creates and runs kitchens in hotels, restaurants and food businesses.

careers.name: Travel & Tourism Manager
careers.short_description: Designs trips and runs travel operations for agencies and tourism boards.
